verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs claim "Built-in pipeline monitoring and alerts", which is the product's own capability for this story. That single marketing-level line is the only evidence; nothing describes per-sync run status, logs, row counts, or how alerts are delivered. missing for 10: documented per-sync run status view, log access per run, row counts per sync, Slack alert integration, email alerts, registrable webhook callbacks on failure, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see run status, logs, and row counts per sync, and failures alert me in Slack, email, or a webhook
